mapper.sql: coalesce( (select t.tpl_id from qms_preship_tpl t where t.item_id = i.item_id and t.use_yn = 'Y' and exists (select 1 from qms_preship_tpl_line tl where tl.tpl_id = t.tpl_id and tl.use_yn = 'Y')), (select t.tpl_id from qms_preship_tpl t where i.item_class_id is not null and t.item_class_id = i.item_class_id and t.use_yn = 'Y' and exists (select 1 from qms_preship_tpl_line tl where tl.tpl_id = t.tpl_id and tl.use_yn = 'Y')))

t.tpl_id, t.tpl_cd, t.tpl_nm, t.item_id, t.item_class_id, case when t.item_id is not null then 'ITEM' else 'CLASS' end as target_type, coalesce(i.item_cd, c.class_cd) as target_cd, coalesce(i.item_nm, c.class_nm) as target_nm, (select count(*) from qms_preship_tpl_line l where l.tpl_id = t.tpl_id and l.use_yn = 'Y') as line_cnt, t.remark, t.use_yn, t.row_ver, t.updated_at, t.updated_by

from qms_preship_tpl t left join mst_item i on i.item_id = t.item_id left join mst_item_class c on c.class_id = t.item_class_id
t.use_yn = #{useYn} and (t.tpl_cd ilike #{kw} escape '\' or t.tpl_nm ilike #{kw} escape '\' or i.item_cd ilike #{kw} escape '\' or c.class_cd ilike #{kw} escape '\')
mapper.select:
select order by
t.tpl_cd t.tpl_nm coalesce(i.item_cd, c.class_cd) t.updated_at
desc,
t.tpl_id limit #{page.size} offset #{page.offset}
select count(*)
select from qms_preship_tpl t left join mst_item i on i.item_id = t.item_id left join mst_item_class c on c.class_id = t.item_class_id where t.tpl_id = #{id}

select l.tpl_line_id, l.seq, l.grp_nm, l.check_text, l.na_allowed_yn, l.photo_req_yn, l.use_yn, l.row_ver from qms_preship_tpl_line l where l.tpl_id = #{id} order by l.use_yn desc, l.seq, l.tpl_line_id
select item_id from mst_item where item_cd = #{cd} and use_yn = 'Y'
select class_id from mst_item_class where class_cd = #{cd} and use_yn = 'Y'

insert into qms_preship_tpl (comp_cd, tpl_cd, tpl_nm, item_id, item_class_id, remark, use_yn, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{f.tplCd}, #{f.tplNm}, #{f.itemId}, #{f.itemClassId}, #{f.remark}, #{f.useYn}, #{by}, #{by}) returning tpl_id

insert into qms_preship_tpl_line (comp_cd, tpl_id, seq, grp_nm, check_text, na_allowed_yn, photo_req_yn, use_yn, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{tplId}, #{l.seq}, #{l.grpNm}, #{l.checkText}, #{l.naAllowedYn}, #{l.photoReqYn}, #{l.useYn}, #{by}, #{by}) returning tpl_line_id
mapper.sql: s.ship_id, s.ship_no, s.plant_cd, s.plan_date, cu.cust_nm, s.status as ship_status, case when exists (select 1 from wms_ship_line sl join mst_item i on i.item_id = sl.item_id where sl.ship_id = s.ship_id and is not null) then 'Y' else 'N' end as required_yn, h.insp_id, h.insp_no, coalesce(h.status, 'NONE') as insp_status, coalesce((select count(*) from qms_preship_result r where r.insp_id = h.insp_id), 0) as result_cnt, coalesce((select count(*) from qms_preship_result r where r.insp_id = h.insp_id and r.judge is not null), 0) as judged_cnt, coalesce((select count(*) from qms_preship_punch p where p.insp_id = h.insp_id and p.status = 'OPEN'), 0) as open_punch_cnt

from wms_ship s join mst_cust cu on cu.cust_id = s.cust_id left join qms_preship_insp h on h.ship_id = s.ship_id and h.status <> 'CANCELLED' where s.status <> 'CANCELLED' and s.plan_date between #{from} and #{to} and (s.ship_no ilike #{kw} escape '\' or cu.cust_nm ilike #{kw} escape '\' or h.insp_no ilike #{kw} escape '\') and coalesce(h.status, 'NONE') = #{insp} and exists (select 1 from wms_ship_line sl join mst_item i on i.item_id = sl.item_id where sl.ship_id = s.ship_id and is not null)
mapper.select:
select order by
s.ship_no cu.cust_nm coalesce(h.status, 'NONE') s.plan_date
desc,
s.ship_id limit #{page.size} offset #{page.offset}
select count(*)
select from wms_ship s join mst_cust cu on cu.cust_id = s.cust_id left join qms_preship_insp h on h.ship_id = s.ship_id and h.status <> 'CANCELLED' where s.ship_id = #{shipId}
select s.status from wms_ship s where s.ship_id = #{shipId} for share

select x.item_id, x.item_cd, x.tpl_id from (select distinct i.item_id, i.item_cd, as tpl_id from wms_ship_line sl join mst_item i on i.item_id = sl.item_id where sl.ship_id = #{shipId}) x where x.tpl_id is not null order by x.item_cd, x.item_id
insert into qms_preship_insp (comp_cd, insp_no, ship_id, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{no}, #{shipId}, #{by}, #{by}) returning insp_id
mapper.insert: insert into qms_preship_result (comp_cd, insp_id, item_id, tpl_id, tpl_line_id, seq, grp_nm, check_text, na_allowed_yn, photo_req_yn, created_by, updated_by) select hb_current_comp(), #{inspId}, #{itemId}, l.tpl_id, l.tpl_line_id, l.seq, l.grp_nm, l.check_text, l.na_allowed_yn, l.photo_req_yn, #{by}, #{by} from qms_preship_tpl_line l where l.tpl_id = #{tplId} and l.use_yn = 'Y' order by l.seq, l.tpl_line_id
mapper.sql: h.insp_id, h.insp_no, h.ship_id, s.ship_no, s.status as ship_status, h.status, h.inspector_nm, h.witness_nm, h.remark, h.done_at, h.done_by, h.cancel_reason, h.row_ver, h.created_at, h.created_by
mapper.select: select from qms_preship_insp h join wms_ship s on s.ship_id = h.ship_id where h.insp_id = #{inspId}
select from qms_preship_insp h join wms_ship s on s.ship_id = h.ship_id where h.ship_id = #{shipId} and h.status <> 'CANCELLED'
mapper.sql: r.result_id, r.insp_id, r.item_id, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, r.seq, r.grp_nm, r.check_text, r.na_allowed_yn, r.photo_req_yn, r.judge, r.remark, r.judged_at, r.judged_by, r.row_ver, (select count(*) from sys_file f where f.target_type = 'qms-preship' and f.target_id = r.result_id::varchar and f.use_yn = 'Y') as file_cnt, p.punch_id as open_punch_id, p.ship_allow_yn as open_punch_allow_yn
mapper.select: select from qms_preship_result r join mst_item i on i.item_id = r.item_id left join qms_preship_punch p on p.result_id = r.result_id and p.status = 'OPEN' where r.insp_id = #{inspId} order by i.item_cd, r.item_id, r.seq, r.result_id
select from qms_preship_result r join mst_item i on i.item_id = r.item_id left join qms_preship_punch p on p.result_id = r.result_id and p.status = 'OPEN' where r.result_id = #{resultId}
select count(*) from sys_file f where f.target_type = 'qms-preship' and f.target_id = #{resultId}::varchar and f.use_yn = 'Y'
select punch_id from qms_preship_punch where result_id = #{resultId} and status = 'OPEN'
insert into qms_preship_punch (comp_cd, insp_id, result_id, issue_text, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{inspId}, #{resultId}, #{issue}, #{by}, #{by}) returning punch_id
select count(*) from qms_preship_result where insp_id = #{inspId} and judge is null
select count(*) from qms_preship_punch where insp_id = #{inspId} and status = 'OPEN' and ship_allow_yn = 'N'
mapper.sql: p.punch_id, p.insp_id, h.insp_no, h.status as insp_status, h.ship_id, s.ship_no, s.status as ship_status, p.result_id, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, r.grp_nm, r.check_text, r.photo_req_yn, p.status, p.issue_text, p.action_text, p.closed_at, p.closed_by, p.ship_allow_yn, p.allow_reason, p.allowed_at, p.allowed_by, p.ncr_id, n.ncr_no, (select count(*) from sys_file f where f.target_type = 'qms-preship' and f.target_id = r.result_id::varchar and f.use_yn = 'Y') as file_cnt, p.row_ver, p.created_at, p.created_by, r.row_ver as result_row_ver

from qms_preship_punch p join qms_preship_insp h on h.insp_id = p.insp_id join wms_ship s on s.ship_id = h.ship_id join qms_preship_result r on r.result_id = p.result_id join mst_item i on i.item_id = r.item_id left join qms_ncr n on n.ncr_id = p.ncr_id

where h.status <> 'CANCELLED' and p.status = #{status} and (s.ship_no ilike #{kw} escape '\' or h.insp_no ilike #{kw} escape '\' or i.item_cd ilike #{kw} escape '\' or r.check_text ilike #{kw} escape '\')

select where p.punch_id = #{punchId} for update of p
mapper.update: update qms_preship_punch set status = 'CLOSED', action_text = #{action}, closed_at = now(), closed_by = #{by}, row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where punch_id = #{punchId} and row_ver = #{rowVer} and status = 'OPEN'

update qms_preship_punch set ship_allow_yn = 'Y', allow_reason = #{reason}, allowed_at = now(), allowed_by = #{by}, row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where punch_id = #{punchId} and row_ver = #{rowVer} and status = 'OPEN' and ship_allow_yn = 'N'
mapper.select: select ncr_id from qms_ncr where ncr_no = #{no}
select distinct i.item_id from wms_ship_line sl join mst_item i on i.item_id = sl.item_id where sl.ship_id = #{shipId} and is not null order by i.item_id

select h.insp_id, h.insp_no, h.status, (select count(*) from qms_preship_punch p where p.insp_id = h.insp_id and p.status = 'OPEN' and p.ship_allow_yn = 'N') as blocking_punch_cnt from qms_preship_insp h where h.ship_id = #{shipId} and h.status <> 'CANCELLED'
select distinct item_id from qms_preship_result where insp_id = #{inspId} order by item_id

select case when h.status = 'DONE' then 'DONE:' || case when exists (select 1 from qms_preship_punch p where p.result_id = r.result_id and p.status = 'OPEN') then 'Y' else 'N' end else h.status end from qms_preship_result r join qms_preship_insp h on h.insp_id = r.insp_id where r.result_id = #{resultId}
